title: Sample: A quiet morning
chinese: 清晨，街道还很安静。我打开窗户，让凉爽的空气进入房间。远处传来几声鸟鸣，一辆早班公交车缓缓驶过。这样的片刻提醒我，不必匆忙开始一天。
english: Early in the morning, the street was still quiet. I opened the window and let the cool air into the room. A few birds were calling in the distance, and an early bus passed slowly by. Moments like this remind me that there is no need to begin the day in a hurry.
